description: 10 table-focused questions grounded in the first 10 VLM-parsed MSFT FY2025 Item 7 tables (pages 33-40). Use to test text+table-summary retrieval and answer quality.

questions.question: What cash dividend per share did Microsoft declare in the dividend table shown in its fiscal year 2025 10-K MD&A?
What was the total dividend amount (in millions) associated with that Microsoft dividend declaration?
questions.notes: Same dividend table; tests retrieval of the amount column.

questions.question: What was Microsoft's total revenue in fiscal year 2025 according to the MD&A summary results table?
What was Microsoft's diluted earnings per share in fiscal year 2025?
questions.notes: EPS row in the FY2025 vs FY2024 summary table.

questions.question: What was Intelligent Cloud revenue in fiscal year 2025?
questions.notes: Segment table; multiple merged tables contain this row.

questions.question: Which Microsoft reporting segment had the highest revenue percentage growth from fiscal year 2024 to fiscal year 2025, and what was that growth rate?
What was More Personal Computing operating income in fiscal year 2025?
questions.notes: Segment operating income at bottom of segment tables.

questions.question: How much did Microsoft spend on research and development in fiscal year 2025, and what percentage of revenue did R&D represent?
What were Microsoft's sales and marketing expenses in fiscal year 2025, and what percent of revenue did they represent?
What was the total other income (expense), net for Microsoft in fiscal year 2025?
questions.notes: Other income/expense components table; negative total.
